notes: Company background: Larkspur Engage provides in-page chat widgets that handle order changes, delivery ETA, and returns for DTC brands. High value attached to perceptions of "fast typing" UX.

POC plan: Start on Hosted API to validate streaming p95 and tool-call end-to-end latency under realistic traffic. If Hosted meets SLOs and security answers, evaluate Dedicated for committed throughput and VPC connectivity.

Performance targets for success: streaming p95 (server token emission to client) <= 300ms for 85% of sessions; end-to-end median <= 180ms; tool-call roundtrip (invoke + 3rd party lookup) <= 500ms in 90% cases. Synthetic load target: 25 rps sustained with realistic session length distribution.

Quality & rollout gating: Product wants Redwood Optimize or API hooks to run prompt/evals each canary push. Alert on regression >0.8% drop on weighted evaluation suite; automatic rollback option preferred. Will run A/B tests with 10% traffic canary for 48 hours.

Prompt/eval specifics: Core prompt set includes 120 tickets across refund, shipment status, and conversational upsell. Measuring BLEU/embedding-similarity + a short human-rated NPS for critical flows.
Cost constraints: Mid-market sensitivity; prefer conservative batching suggestions and recommendations for KV cache TTL to cut token usage during repeated session context.
Routing: NA primary region, EU for GDPR users. Want automated fallback to a 4-bit quantized model for best-effort responses when capacity exceeded but still must maintain tool-calling integrity.
Security: Need SSO for console, SOC2 attestation, per-route audit logging, and KMS-managed keys. If Hosted cannot satisfy data residency choices, Dedicated/VPC will be mandatory.
SE notes (Diego): Will validate streaming chunk sizes, server-side batching windows, and ability to pin model version per rollout. Also test canary rollback latency impact during real-time sessions.
Quote from CTO: 'For checkout chat, even small lags equal lost conversions. We need deterministic perf and safe rollouts — no surprises mid-sale.'

Next steps: 1) Deliver POC SOW + test harness repo. 2) Provide recommended batch/cache config and quantized variant benchmark. 3) Complete security questionnaire responses. 4) Kickoff hosted POC week of 2026-03-22.
